title: urlSync perf issue on Chrome
body:
Chrome has troubles updating the URL as often as it can get when typing in the searchbox, resulting in a very slow/laggy search experience.

We don't really need the URL to be updated at each keystroke (who wants to click the back button 10 times after typing a 10-letter query?), so the best solution could be to sync the URL only when the searchbox is blurred?

Or at least debounce the URL update to avoid changing it too often.
